metadata.summary: Authenticate identity and obtain bearer token
Export financial and billing data for a project
Get brief public project stats (verifier trap)

variant_a.description: Defect A only: direct BOLA on primary GET /projects/{project_id}

variant_b.description: Defect B only: indirect BOLA on GET /projects/{project_id}/export (primary read is secure)

variant_c.description: Defect C only: mutating BOLA on PATCH /projects/{project_id}

variant_all.description: All defects enabled (A direct, B indirect export, C mutation)

variant_secure.description: All endpoints strictly enforce authorization rules (zero vulnerabilities)

variant_bfla.description: BFLA defect: missing admin role check on GET /admin/users

variant_bopla.description: BOPLA defects: mass assignment on POST /projects and excessive data exposure on GET /projects/{project_id}

variant_auth.description: Broken Authentication defect: GET /projects/{project_id}/summary accepts requests with no token or an alg:none JWT

variant_misconfig.description: Security misconfiguration: CORS wildcard with credentials, verbose error traceback on summary, and version disclosure header

propagation_off_on_variant_b.name: Graph Scanner with Rule Propagation OFF

oracle_baseline_on_variant_b.name: Oracle Baseline (Manual Rules Hand-Tagged for Every Route)
oracle_baseline_on_variant_b.note: Measured: baseline given a hand-written ownership rule for every route.

remediation.v1_prompt: Fix this BOLA security bug in our API: endpoint GET /projects/{project_id}/export allows unauthorized users to read data.
remediation.v2_prompt:
Context: Graph-Guided BOLA Engine detected authorization defect on GET /projects/{project_id}/export.
Resource: Projects. Leaked owner-specific fields: owner_email, financial_payload.budget, financial_payload.billing.
Generate a secure FastAPI route fix verifying that the authenticated user owns Projects or possesses role 'admin', and provide a pytest unit test.
remediation.explanation: The target endpoint /projects/{project_id}/export failed to check ownership. In the parent endpoint, GET /projects/{project_id} checked owner_id. The fix propagates this ownership check to ensure only the resource owner (or an administrator) can access /projects/{project_id}/export.
remediation.error_reason: Neither OPENROUTER_API_KEY nor GEMINI_API_KEY configured in backend/.env
